name: ax-genealogy
description: Read and keep a family's genealogy on an ax·genealogy site, as one of its accounts.
long_description: The community connector of the MCP of an ax·genealogy site (axgf-cms). Give it the site's address and a token made on your account's page: your assistant can then search the family, read records, and — if the token may write — add people, correct names and dates, record events and unions, all checked by the site with your account's rights, and journalled under your name.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: A person's record, relatives and events.

tools.name: create_person
tools.description: Add a person, with parents, siblings and unions.

tools.name: update_person
tools.description: Change names, gender, living state, visibility, biography.

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Add a life event: baptism, burial, migration…

tools.name: add_child
tools.description: Make a person the child of parents or a family.

tools.name: remove_child
tools.description: Take a child out of a family.

tools.name: apply_operations
tools.description: Apply a batch, all or nothing.

site_url.title: Site address
site_url.description: The address of the ax·genealogy site, such as https://family.example

token.title: Access token
token.description: A token made on your account's page of the site (My account → Access tokens). It acts as your account.
